## Description

What does this change do and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (tests added/updated where behavior changed)
- [ ] Safety invariants preserved (tool registry deny-by-default, Security Gate, taint rules)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / CHANGELOG) where relevant

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
